description: Dependency updates (spec/03 §7, #656): weekly and grouped, versions kept exact. Renovate reads the pnpm catalog in pnpm-workspace.yaml, which Dependabot can't.

packageRules.description: Every minor and patch update in one pull request a week; each major on its own.
Electron on its own (risk R7): upgraded at least once a quarter, its patches and minors as they come.
A new Electron major waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard: it's planned for a phase boundary (R7).
Playwright's package and CI's Playwright container move together: local and CI screenshots must use the same image (tools/src/visual-docker.ts).

Puck on its own, and only once approved on the Dependency Dashboard: only packages/engine imports it, its patch (pnpm-workspace.yaml) must be made again for a new version, and an upgrade needs pnpm e2e:perf (ADR 0007).
Playwright stays on 1.64 until it bundles a Firefox that doesn't crash the exported tabs test (#839). Remove this rule then.
Babel stays on 7: the React Compiler's plugin is built against it (ADR 0010, #833). Remove this rule once babel-plugin-react-compiler supports Babel 8.
